additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens,
We kindly require one of your staff for on-site support for the EV charger located at 33 Jalan Buroh. We were informed by your staff Edna to contact this email for future matters regarding EV chargers.
Kindly advise if you can arrange your staff on-site this Friday 16 Jan at 2pm at the mentioned station location?

Kindly advise.
Thank you,
Daniel
TotalEnergies Charging Services Singapore
